ios.desc:
How it works
SmokeLessTimer uses a smart timer that automatically increases after each cigarette smoked or according to a schedule you set. This gradually lengthens your smoking breaks, gently weaning you off nicotine.

Features to support you

Incremental Timer
The core of the app. A timer that adapts and helps you increase the intervals.

Flexible Settings
Customize the timer and the increment mode to your personal needs.

Smoking Calendar
A calendar showing your smoke-free days and the number of cigarettes smoked per day.

Detailed Statistics
Track your progress, see how many fewer cigarettes you smoke, and how much money you've spent.

Full Cost Control
Keep track of your expenses. The app shows you exactly how much money you spend on cigarettes.

Apple Watch App, more convenient tracking.
Small and Big Widgets for Watch face and fast adding button.
